summary: United Microelectronics Corp. filed a Form 6-K announcing the cumulative repurchase of 4,166,000 common shares (0.03% of outstanding) for NTD $375,536,827 (approx. NTD $90.14 per share), exceeding the NTD $300 million threshold. This is an issuer tender/buyback program, not an acquisition or restructuring. The filing serves as a routine disclosure under NYSE Rule 10b5-1 or local law; no advisor or board recommendation is cited. As a Taiwanese filer, the 6-K maps to a US 8-K disclosure of share repurchase activity. Watch for ongoing buyback execution and potential EPS accretion; minimal premium or overhang impact.
